work.title: Review variance and stdev implementation in calc
work.result:
APPROVE: commit 10096c0 matches the requirement.

- variance([1,2,3,4]) is 1.25, population (divide by n). Sample variance would be 5/3.
- stdev is variance(xs) ** 0.5 (sqrt(1.25) == 1.118033988749895).
- Both call list(xs) first, so generators and iterators work; tests cover iter([...]) and a generator expression.
- Empty input raises ValueError("variance of empty sequence") and ValueError("stdev of empty sequence"), same shape as mean().
- variance() calls mean(); stdev() calls variance(). Style matches calc/__init__.py.
- tests/test_calc.py stays in the existing unittest style and covers known values, a constant sequence, iterables, and both empty-input errors.
- tests/__init__.py is an empty package marker. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and the README command python3 -m unittest discover -s tests both ran 8 tests, OK. No code changes made.
